brief:
Hamas political bureau member Haroun Nasreddine, who heads the movement's Jerusalem affairs office, warned against the imposition of an Israeli educational curriculum on students in occupied Jerusalem, Shehab Wire reported. Nasreddine characterized the measure as part of a systematic project designed to reshape Palestinian consciousness and identity among the city's youth population.

The Hamas official described the curriculum mandate as an assault on Palestinian identity and a bid to uproot Palestinian awareness. He framed the educational policy as one element of a broader, coordinated effort by Israeli occupation authorities to alter the ideological foundations of Jerusalem's student body through state-mandated schooling.

title: Hamas warns against Israeli curriculum imposed on Jerusalem students
